source: Written 2026-10-15 from the verified oracle text (Scryfall, fetched 2026-10-15) for every card a scene shows or names, Scryfall's rulings (The Ur-Sphinx; Unesh, Criosphinx Sovereign; Yennett, Cryptic Sovereign; Defiler of Dreams; Warden of Evos Isle; Windreader Sphinx; Consecrated Sphinx; Enigma Sphinx; Atemsis, All-Seeing; Magister Sphinx; Medomai the Ageless; Sphinx Sovereign; Time Wipe) and this deck's notes. Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named. No power or toughness is stated. Cost math: the {1} and {2} discounts cut only generic mana (CR 118.7a; Warden ruling), apply in any order and never below {0} (CR 601.2f), and never change a card's mana value (Unesh, Warden and Enigma Sphinx rulings); Defiler's own text limits it to blue. Eminence says "other", so The Ur-Sphinx's own cost uses only Unesh, Warden and Defiler; Unesh doesn't discount itself, and you, not the opponent, choose which pile goes to hand (Unesh rulings). The attack: the free spells are cast while the trigger resolves, card-type timing is ignored, there are no alternative costs and X is 0 (The Ur-Sphinx rulings; CR 608.2g for casting during resolution); you control a spell you cast (CR 601.2a), so a permanent cast from an opponent's milled cards enters under your control (CR 608.3a), and an instant or sorcery goes to its owner's graveyard (CR 608.2n); mill is CR 701.17a. Attackers tap (CR 508.1f) unless they have vigilance like Yennett (CR 702.20b), and untap only in your untap step (CR 502.3), so an attacking Sphinx Sovereign is still tapped at your end step (Sovereign ruling: checked as the trigger resolves). Cascade triggers on any cast, a free one included (CR 702.85a). Atemsis: a card with no mana cost has mana value 0, and 0 counts (ruling); the damaged opponent loses. Magister Sphinx's trigger isn't optional, and a player below 10 gains life from it (rulings). Commander starting life is 40 (CR 903.7). Commander tax applies only to casts from the command zone (CR 903.8), and a commander returned to hand may stay there (CR 903.9b); eminence works only from the command zone or the battlefield (oracle text), so it is off while the Ur-Sphinx waits in hand. Changeling Wayfinder is every creature type (CR 702.73a), which makes 30 Sphinxes in the 99. The Mind Stone stays harnessed until it leaves the battlefield (CR 701.64b) and has its ∞ ability while harnessed (CR 702.186b); its blink returns the card under its owner's control (oracle text).

scenes.head: The Ur-Sphinx — Esper Sphinxes
scenes.sub: White, blue and black: 30 Sphinxes in the 99, and a commander that works before you ever cast it.
scenes.say: The Ur-Sphinx. Sphinx tribal in white, blue and black, with thirty Sphinxes in the ninety-nine, and a commander that works before you ever cast it.

scenes.head: Eminence: it works from the command zone
scenes.sub: As long as The Ur-Sphinx is in the command zone or on the battlefield, other Sphinx spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
scenes.say: Eminence. As long as The Ur-Sphinx is in the command zone or on the battlefield, your other Sphinx spells cost one less to cast. From turn one.

scenes.head: Then it attacks
scenes.sub: Whenever one or more Sphinxes you control attack, each player mills that many cards. For each player, you may cast a card that player milled this way without paying its mana cost.
scenes.say: Then it attacks. Whenever one or more Sphinxes you control attack, each player mills that many cards. And for each player, you may cast one of the cards that player milled, without paying its mana cost.

scenes.head: Three attack, so everyone mills three
scenes.sub: Up to four free spells at a four-player table: one from each player's milled cards, yours included. More attackers means more choice, not more casts.
scenes.say: Three Sphinxes attack, so every player mills three. At a four-player table that's up to four free spells: one from each player's milled cards, your own included. More attackers give you more to choose from, not more casts.

scenes.head: Make them cheap
scenes.sub: [[Unesh, Criosphinx Sovereign|Unesh]] takes {2} off Sphinx spells and [[Warden of Evos Isle|Warden]] {1} off fliers. [[Defiler of Dreams|Defiler]] takes {U} off a blue permanent spell for 2 life.
scenes.say: Make them cheap. Unesh takes two off your Sphinx spells, and Warden of Evos Isle takes one off creature spells with flying. Defiler of Dreams takes one blue off a blue permanent spell, for two life.

scenes.head: Turn every Sphinx into cards
scenes.sub: Unesh reveals four whenever a Sphinx you control enters. [[Windreader Sphinx]] draws whenever a flier attacks. [[Consecrated Sphinx]] draws two whenever an opponent draws.
scenes.say: Turn every Sphinx into cards. Unesh reveals four whenever it or another Sphinx you control enters. Windreader Sphinx draws whenever a creature with flying attacks. And Consecrated Sphinx draws you two whenever an opponent draws.

scenes.head: Make them cheap. Draw cards. Attack for free spells.
scenes.sub: Four clips follow: the discounts, the card engine, the attack, and how the deck wins.
scenes.say: Make them cheap. Draw cards. Attack for free spells. Four clips follow: the discounts, the card engine, the attack, and how the deck wins.

scenes.head: Three discounts on generic mana
scenes.sub: Eminence: {1} off your other Sphinx spells. [[Unesh, Criosphinx Sovereign|Unesh]]: {2} off Sphinx spells. [[Warden of Evos Isle|Warden]]: {1} off creature spells with flying.
scenes.say: Three discounts on generic mana. Eminence takes one off your other Sphinx spells. Unesh takes two off Sphinx spells. Warden of Evos Isle takes one off creature spells with flying. On a flying Sphinx, that's up to four less.

scenes.head: [[Defiler of Dreams|Defiler]]: blue mana for life
scenes.sub: Pay 2 life as you cast a blue permanent spell: it costs {U} less. That cuts only blue. Each blue permanent spell you cast also draws a card.
scenes.say: Defiler of Dreams: blue mana for life. As you cast a blue permanent spell, you may pay two life, and it costs one blue less. Each blue permanent spell you cast also draws you a card, and every printed Sphinx here is blue.

scenes.head: Generic mana only
scenes.sub: The {1} and {2} discounts never pay a colored pip. With all three out, [[Azor, the Lawbringer|Azor]] ({2}{W}{W}{U}{U}) still costs {W}{W}{U}{U}, or {W}{W}{U} and 2 life with Defiler.
scenes.say: Generic mana only. The one and two discounts never pay a colored pip. With all three out, Azor still costs two white and two blue. Pay two life to Defiler, and it's two white and one blue.

scenes.head: Turn 4: Unesh for four
scenes.sub: [[Warden of Evos Isle|Warden]] came down on turn 3. [[Unesh, Criosphinx Sovereign|Unesh]] ({4}{U}{U}) loses one to eminence and one to Warden: {2}{U}{U}.
scenes.say: Turn four: Unesh for four. Warden came down on turn three. Unesh costs six: one off for eminence and one for Warden, so two generic and two blue. Its own discount doesn't apply to itself.

scenes.head: Turn 5: Defiler for two
scenes.sub: [[Defiler of Dreams|Defiler]] ({3}{U}{U}) loses four generic but has only three: {U}{U}. It's a Sphinx, so Unesh reveals four.
scenes.say: Turn five: Defiler of Dreams for two. Four generic comes off, but it only has three, so it costs just two blue. It's a Sphinx, so Unesh reveals four more cards.

scenes.head: Then Consecrated Sphinx for one blue
scenes.sub: [[Consecrated Sphinx]] ({4}{U}{U}) loses all four generic: {U}{U}. Pay 2 life to Defiler: {U}. Defiler draws a card, and Unesh reveals four again.
scenes.say: Then Consecrated Sphinx for one blue mana. All four generic comes off, leaving two blue. Pay two life to Defiler, and one blue comes off too. Defiler draws you a card, and Unesh reveals four again.

scenes.head: The commander gets three of the four
scenes.sub: Eminence says "other", but Unesh, Warden and Defiler apply: [[The Ur-Sphinx]] ({6}{W}{U}{B}) costs {3}{W}{B} and 2 life on its first cast.
scenes.say: The commander gets three of the four. Eminence says other Sphinx spells, so it never discounts the Ur-Sphinx itself. Unesh, Warden and Defiler all do: on its first cast it costs three generic, a white and a black, plus two life.

scenes.head: Discounts first, then the big Sphinxes
scenes.sub: Cast Warden and Unesh early. Every Sphinx after them costs less and brings a pile.
scenes.say: Discounts first, then the big Sphinxes. Cast Warden and Unesh early, and every Sphinx after them costs less, and brings a pile of cards with it.

scenes.head: [[Unesh, Criosphinx Sovereign|Unesh]]: four cards, two piles
scenes.sub: Whenever Unesh or another Sphinx you control enters, reveal the top four. An opponent splits them into two piles; you pick the one for your hand.
scenes.say: Unesh: four cards, two piles. Whenever Unesh or another Sphinx you control enters, reveal the top four cards. An opponent splits them into two piles, and you choose which pile goes to your hand. The other goes to your graveyard.

scenes.head: The other pile isn't wasted
scenes.sub: Its creatures come back with [[Rise of the Dark Realms]]. [[Sphinx of Forgotten Lore|Forgotten Lore]] gives an instant or sorcery there flashback; [[Scholar of the Lost Trove|Scholar]] casts one free.
scenes.say: The other pile isn't wasted. Rise of the Dark Realms brings its creatures back. Sphinx of Forgotten Lore gives an instant or sorcery there flashback when it attacks, and Scholar of the Lost Trove casts one free when it enters.

scenes.head: [[Defiler of Dreams|Defiler]]: a card per blue permanent
scenes.sub: Whenever you cast a blue permanent spell, draw a card. Every printed Sphinx in this deck is blue, and so is [[Rhystic Study]].
scenes.say: Defiler of Dreams: a card for every blue permanent. Whenever you cast a blue permanent spell, draw a card. Every printed Sphinx in this deck is blue, and so is Rhystic Study.

scenes.head: [[Windreader Sphinx]]: every flier draws
scenes.sub: Whenever a creature with flying attacks, you may draw a card. Yours or theirs, and Windreader itself. Four fliers attack: four cards.
scenes.say: Windreader Sphinx: every flier draws. Whenever a creature with flying attacks, you may draw a card. It doesn't matter whose creature it is, and Windreader counts itself. Attack with four fliers, and draw four.

scenes.head: [[Consecrated Sphinx]]: two for each of theirs
scenes.sub: Whenever an opponent draws a card, you may draw two. Three opponents draw for their turns: six cards before your next one.
scenes.say: Consecrated Sphinx: two for each of theirs. Whenever an opponent draws a card, you may draw two. Three opponents' draw steps make six cards before your next turn. Cast it when you can untap with it.

scenes.head: Stack them: [[Sphinx of Enlightenment]]
scenes.sub: Defiler draws one as you cast it. When it enters, an opponent draws one and you draw three, and Consecrated adds two: six cards, plus a Unesh pile.
scenes.say: Stack them. Cast Sphinx of Enlightenment, and Defiler draws you a card. When it enters, target opponent draws one and you draw three. Consecrated Sphinx sees their draw and gives you two more. That's six cards, plus a pile from Unesh.

scenes.head: [[Rhystic Study]] taxes the table
scenes.sub: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, you may draw a card unless that player pays {1}.
scenes.say: Rhystic Study taxes the table. Whenever an opponent casts a spell, you may draw a card, unless that player pays one mana.

scenes.head: Cheap Sphinxes, full hand
scenes.sub: With Unesh and Defiler out, each blue Sphinx draws a card on cast and reveals four on entry.
scenes.say: Cheap Sphinxes, and a full hand. With Unesh and Defiler out, each blue Sphinx draws you a card as you cast it, and reveals four more as it enters.

scenes.head: Three Sphinxes attack
scenes.sub: [[Swiftfoot Boots]] gave [[The Ur-Sphinx]] hexproof and haste: it swings the turn it lands, with [[Unesh, Criosphinx Sovereign|Unesh]] and [[Yennett, Cryptic Sovereign|Yennett]].
scenes.say: Three Sphinxes attack. Swiftfoot Boots gave The Ur-Sphinx hexproof and haste, so it swings the turn it lands, along with Unesh and Yennett. Yennett has vigilance, so it doesn't tap.

scenes.head: Three attacked: each player mills three
scenes.sub: Yours: [[Magister Sphinx]], [[Time Wipe]] and an [[Island]]. Each opponent puts their top three into their graveyard too.
scenes.say: Three Sphinxes attacked, so each player mills three. Yours are Magister Sphinx, Time Wipe and an Island. Each opponent puts their top three cards into their graveyard too.

scenes.head: One free spell from each player
scenes.sub: From yours, [[Magister Sphinx]]. From each opponent's three, the best card, cast by you. Up to four spells, no mana spent.
scenes.say: One free spell from each player. From your three, Magister Sphinx. From each opponent's three, their best card, cast by you. That's up to four spells, and no mana spent.

scenes.head: Cast them now, at any speed
scenes.sub: You cast them while the trigger resolves, not later in the turn. Card-type timing is ignored: sorceries and creatures can be cast mid-combat. Any {X} is 0.
scenes.say: Cast them now, at any speed. You cast these spells while the trigger resolves; you can't save them for later. Timing based on card type is ignored, so sorceries and creatures can be cast mid-combat. Any X is zero.

scenes.head: You cast it, so you control it
scenes.sub: A permanent spell you cast from an opponent's pile enters under your control. An instant or sorcery goes back to its owner's graveyard once it resolves.
scenes.say: You cast it, so you control it. A creature or artifact you cast from an opponent's pile enters the battlefield under your control. An instant or sorcery goes to its owner's graveyard once it resolves.

scenes.head: [[Yennett, Cryptic Sovereign|Yennett]]: odd is free
scenes.sub: Whenever Yennett attacks, reveal your top card. Odd mana value: you may cast it free. Otherwise, draw it. [[Enigma Sphinx]] is a 7, [[Rise of the Dark Realms]] a 9.
scenes.say: Yennett: odd is free. Whenever Yennett attacks, reveal your top card. If its mana value is odd, you may cast it for free. If you don't, you draw it. Enigma Sphinx is a seven, and a free cast still cascades.

scenes.head: More attack triggers
scenes.sub: [[Azor, the Lawbringer|Azor]]: pay {X}{W}{U}{U} to gain X life and draw X. [[Elenda and Azor]]: pay {X}{W}{U}{B} to draw X. [[Raffine, Scheming Seer|Raffine]]: an attacker connives X, X being the number of attackers.
scenes.say: More attack triggers. Azor, and Elenda and Azor, both let you pay X plus three colored mana to draw X cards. Azor gains you X life too. And whenever you attack, Raffine makes an attacker connive X, X being the number of attackers.

scenes.head: [[Magister Sphinx]]: life becomes 10
scenes.sub: When it enters, target player's life total becomes 10: from the starting 40, that's 30 gone. Aim high: at 4, they'd gain 6.
scenes.say: Magister Sphinx: life becomes ten. When it enters, target player's life total becomes ten: from the starting forty, that's thirty gone. It isn't optional, so aim high. A player at four would gain six.

scenes.head: [[Sphinx Sovereign]]: each opponent loses 3
scenes.sub: At your end step, you gain 3 life if it's untapped; otherwise each opponent loses 3. Attack with it, and it's still tapped then.
scenes.say: Sphinx Sovereign: each opponent loses three. At the beginning of your end step, you gain three life if it's untapped. Otherwise, each opponent loses three. Attack with it, and it's still tapped when your end step begins.

scenes.head: [[Medomai the Ageless|Medomai]]: one extra turn
scenes.sub: Combat damage to a player: take an extra turn after this one. It can't attack in extra turns, but your other Sphinxes can: another Ur-Sphinx mill.
scenes.say: Medomai: one extra turn. Whenever it deals combat damage to a player, take an extra turn after this one. It can't attack during extra turns, so it never chains. Your other Sphinxes can, and with The Ur-Sphinx out, that's another mill.

scenes.head: [[Atemsis, All-Seeing|Atemsis]]: six mana values
scenes.sub: Whenever it deals damage to an opponent, you may reveal your hand. Six different mana values revealed: that player loses the game. A land counts as 0.
scenes.say: Atemsis: six mana values. Whenever Atemsis deals damage to an opponent, you may reveal your hand. If it shows six different mana values, that player loses the game. This hand shows zero to five: the Island counts as zero.

scenes.head: [[Time Wipe]], then recast
scenes.sub: Return a creature you control to its owner's hand, then destroy all creatures. Save [[Unesh, Criosphinx Sovereign|Unesh]] for a new pile, or [[The Ur-Sphinx]]: from hand, it recasts tax-free.
scenes.say: Time Wipe, then recast. Return a creature you control to its owner's hand, then destroy all creatures. Save Unesh for a new pile, or The Ur-Sphinx: from your hand it recasts with no tax, though eminence is off until then.

scenes.head: [[Rise of the Dark Realms]]: every graveyard is yours
scenes.sub: Put all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control. The mills, Unesh's piles and Time Wipe filled them.
scenes.say: Rise of the Dark Realms. Put all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control: everything the mills, the piles and Time Wipe put there. Yennett and the Ur-Sphinx's mill can even cast it for free.

scenes.head: [[The Mind Stone]], harnessed
scenes.sub: Harness it once ({5}{W}, tap). Then at each of your end steps, blink another nonland permanent of yours: [[Unesh, Criosphinx Sovereign|Unesh]] for a pile, [[Magister Sphinx|Magister]] for another 10.
scenes.say: Harness The Mind Stone once, for five and a white and a tap. Then at each of your end steps, blink another nonland permanent you control: Unesh for a pile, Magister for another ten. Blink only your own cards: theirs go home.

scenes.head: The Ur-Sphinx
scenes.sub: Bracket 3 · 30 Sphinxes · the full plan is in the Plan tab.
scenes.say: The Ur-Sphinx. Bracket three, with thirty Sphinxes. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
